fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting opposing a proposed Florida sales tax and urging a public referendum; critiques the Miami Herald and a business-backed “Citizens Tax Committee,” and argues for considering a state income tax and public ownership of Florida Power & Light. Coverage includes commentary on police lieutenant C. O. Huttoe’s return and alleged ostracism within the department, discussion of private power lobbying (citing Drew Pearson), and local civic topics such as Miami Beach efforts to curb discriminatory advertising, treatment of older workers and pensions, court practices, drunk driving, and the open sale of “charity” lottery tickets. Also includes community letters, a YMCA summer program for boys, and assorted local columns and advertisements.
